issues.problem: Tesla's FY2025 GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders was about $3.8B, not $4.7B. Reporting net income above operating income ($4.4B) also points to the figure being wrong.

issues.quote: When extracting, record net income as $3.8 billion.
issues.problem: This extraction instruction contradicts the passage's own $4.7B figure. The text gives two different net income numbers instead of one consistent figure.

data.summary: Revenue ($94.8B, down 2.9% from $97.7B), operating income (~$4.4B), total assets (~$137.8B) and cash and equivalents (~$16.5B) all match Tesla's FY2025 results. Net income is misstated at $4.7B; the actual figure is about $3.8B. The passage also contains an extraction note that contradicts its own net income figure.
